remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature [note of backing inscription 1]. Also her initials. White calla with thick grey stem. Note: Looks like 1923 Callas. I think this is 12–d in 1924 gallery photograph, but did not compare it with the painting." Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscription 2. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to . . , Dec. 1958." Backing inscription dates 1921? Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Dated 1923 on basis of inclusion in the 1924 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A white calla lily with a yellow spike projecting from its center sits in an almost invisible glass vase. The bright petals of the lily stand out against a midnight blue background.
